verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat lets developers ask natural-language questions to explain concepts, propose fixes, and Copilot Autofix gives contextual explanations for vulnerabilities — core debugging/troubleshooting use cases are directly documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence specifically validating debugging/troubleshooting workflows (community quotes cover general coding assistance, not debugging-specific queries) and a concrete example of a resolved bug via chat.
